event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 34 Date 08 July 2018 Time 11:41 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 33), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 6th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) and 5th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGUK) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Penalty of a drop of 10 grid positions, which is superseded by the previous requirement to start from the pit lane (document 25). As the car did not participate in qualifying it will be placed behind any cars starting from the pit lane that did, in accordance with Art 36.2.
